verdict.rationale: Khoj's first-party docs say you can talk to it by voice on the web, Desktop and Obsidian apps, and that a speaker icon reads any reply aloud. The GitHub README corroborates this with 'talk out loud, play your messages', covering both voice input and spoken replies. missing for 10: explicit evidence that voice is transcribed into text, evidence of live real-time voice conversation mode, voice-note handling on messaging surfaces like WhatsApp, independent or hands-on corroboration.
